SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.title: Speakeasy
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.INITIAL.descript:
A plain door at the end of an alley. Music leaks up from somewhere below. A slot at eye level slides open, and two eyes look you over.

"Password?"
[gold]Finish your drink[/gold]. Choose 1 of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Upgraded[/gold] Tavern cards.
Even odds: get in free and choose 1 of [blue]3[/blue] Tavern cards, or get thrown out and lose [red]{BouncerHpLoss}[/red] HP.
Walk back the way you came.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.SWORDFISH.descri: The door swings open. Downstairs: a trumpet, low light, and a bartender who already knows what you're having. You drink it. All of it.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.SWORDFISH.select: Choose a Tavern card to add to your deck.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.BLUFF_IN.descrip: A long pause. "...Right this way." You decide not to ask what you said.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.BLUFF_IN.selecti: Choose a Tavern card to add to your deck.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.BLUFF_OUT.descri: The door opens just long enough for the bouncer to throw you back into the alley.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.LEAVE.descriptio: You leave. Somewhere below, a whole room laughs at a joke you'll never hear.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.title: Seven Grand
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.INITIAL.descri: A whiskey bar done up like a hunting lodge: plaid, leather, a stag's head keeping an eye on the room. Behind the bar, a wall of bottles climbs to the ceiling. Somewhere in the back, pool balls click.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.INITIAL.option: Take a [gold]Shot[/gold]. Obtain a random Rare relic.
Bet [blue]50[/blue] Gold on a game of pool. Win: gain [blue]100[/blue] Gold. Lose: lose the bet and take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.BARTENDERS_PIC: The bartender reaches for the top shelf without looking. It burns all the way down, and leaves something behind.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.FLIGHT.descrip: Three small glasses, three long stories. You remember about half of each.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.POOL_WIN.descr: You sink the eight ball on a bank shot you'll be bragging about for weeks.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.POOL_LOSE.desc: You scratch on the eight. Loser drinks.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.LEAVE.descript: You leave the whiskey to the stag.
